verdicts.evidence: Just so you know, this call is recorded for quality and training purposes.
verdicts.reason: The agent disclosed recording within the first minute.

verdicts.evidence: Before we go any further, could I please confirm your full name and your date of birth?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked for full name and date of birth before discussing the customer's details or quote, and confirmed the details at 00:38.

verdicts.evidence: Before I talk you through anything, can I ask a bit about your situation and what made you look into life cover?
verdicts.reason: The agent asked about circumstances and motivation before recommending cover, and followed up with questions on existing cover and debts.

verdicts.evidence: In the first twelve months only accidental death is covered, so if you passed away from an illness in that first year, it wouldn't pay out.
verdicts.reason: Cover range, no medical exam, first-year accidental-only cover, stepped premiums and the 30-day cooling-off period all match the product facts. The indicative premium figures are not contradicted by the facts.

verdicts.evidence: That's completely fine, there's no rush at all. You can take your time and decide whenever you're ready, or not at all.
verdicts.reason: After the customer said she could not take it in, the agent explicitly removed urgency and let her decide in her own time.
No sale was completed; the customer declined to proceed and asked for documents by post.

verdicts.evidence: Would you like me to run through the health questions now, so we can see if you'd be accepted?
verdicts.reason: The customer showed bereavement, money worry and memory problems, but the agent did not check understanding or offer a call back. It pushed on to health questions after she said she forgot things. It did slow down at 04:57 and referred to a trusted person at 05:32, which partly mitigates this.

verdicts.evidence: Just so you're aware, anything I tell you today is general advice only. It doesn't take into account your personal objectives, financial situation or needs
verdicts.reason: The agent stated the advice was general and did not take personal circumstances into account.
